hash_scope: release_tree_sha256 hashes each regular file sorted by POSIX path using relative path + NUL + file bytes + NUL, excluding .git metadata and this RELEASE_HASH.json marker. remote_additive_tree_sha256 uses the same algorithm but also excludes README.md and LICENSE because those two user-created remote files are preserved byte-for-byte. The corresponding remote_preserved_file_sha256 values record those files separately. Set hashes use sorted plugin:tree lines with LF.
